post_clip.description: A sudden violent structural failure or explosion occurs: the large tanker truck rapidly collapses/ruptures from left to right across frames 6–12, with visible deformation, detachment of parts, and rapid outward movement of debris and smoke/dust—consistent with an instantaneous blast or catastrophic rupture, not a slow mechanical failure. The person in red cap remains stationary but appears to react (slight flinch/posture shift) as the event unfolds.

Sudden bright flash and violent disruption at frame 8 (timestamp ~84s), followed by rapid camera shake, blurring, and apparent debris/motion consistent with an explosion; the scene transitions from static to chaotic in a fraction of a second, matching the expected signature of an instantaneous blast.

A sudden bright flash and intense illumination emanate from the front of the yellow truck (around frame 10), accompanied by visible debris/dust cloud expanding outward—consistent with an explosion or violent rupture. The person nearby recoils sharply and moves away rapidly, indicating a sudden hazardous event. No prior indication of fire or collision; the onset is instantaneous and matches the expected signature of an explosion.
